nodes.description: DSAuth.owner: privileged address set from msg.sender in the constructor
DSAuth.authority: external DSAuthority used to delegate authorization decisions
DSValue.val: stored 32-byte oracle value
DSValue.has: validity flag of the stored value
Medianizer.min: minimum number of valid feeds required, used as loop/return guard in compute()
Medianizer.next: monotonically increasing feed position counter
PriceFeed.val: posted price value
PriceFeed.zzz: timestamp until which the posted value is valid
PriceOracleInterface.priceFeedSource: external Medianizer address used for price lookups
PriceOracleInterface.owner: privileged operator of the interface
PriceOracleInterface.emergencyMode: when true getUSDETHPrice returns a fixed price of 600
Proxied.masterCopy: implementation contract address used by delegatecall
DutchExchange.auctioneer: privileged role guarding parameter changes
DutchExchange.ethToken: ERC-20 representation of ether
DutchExchange.ethUSDOracle: external oracle interface used for valuations
DutchExchange.balances: token => user => deposit balance
DutchExchange.sellerBalances: per auction seller claimable amounts
DutchExchange.buyerBalances: per auction buyer claimable amounts
DutchExchange.closingPrices: token pair => auction index => final fraction
DutchExchange.sellVolumesCurrent: running auction sell volume
DutchExchange.sellVolumesNext: buffered sell volume for the next auction
DutchExchange.buyVolumes: buy volume accumulated in the running auction
DutchExchange.extraTokens: fees collected per auction, redistributed to buyers
DutchExchange.frtToken: Magnolia fee-reduction token contract
DutchExchange.owlToken: OWL token used to pay half of the fee
TokenFRT.lockedTokenBalances: user => locked (fee reducing) balance
TokenFRT.unlockedTokens: user => pending unlock amount and withdrawal time
TokenFRT.minter: address allowed to mint locked token balances
StandardTokenData.totalTokens: total ERC-20 supply
TokenOWL.minter: address allowed to mint OWL
TokenOWL.creator: administrative owner role
TokenOWL.masterCopyCountdown: pending implementation and activation time (30 days)
PriceOracleInterface constructor setting owner and priceFeedSource without zero checks
DSAuth constructor assigning owner = msg.sender
DSAuth.setOwner, guarded by auth modifier, reassigns the owner
DSAuth.setAuthority, guarded by auth modifier, reassigns the authority contract
DSAuth.isAuthorized: access-control decision, delegates to authority.canCall for third parties
DSValue.poke: authenticated write of a new oracle value
DSValue.peek: returns stored value and validity flag
DSValue.read: reverts unless a valid value is present
Medianizer.compute: iterates registered feeds calling DSValue.peek and computes the median price
Medianizer.set: registers/unregisters a feed address at a position
PriceFeed.post: writes price and expiry then forwards an arbitrary call to the oracle
PriceFeed.peek: returns price and whether now < zzz
PriceFeed.read: asserts now < zzz before returning the value
PriceOracleInterface.getUSDETHPrice: queries the external Medianizer and normalizes the price
PriceOracleInterface.raiseEmergency: onlyOwner toggle of emergencyMode
PriceOracleInterface.updateCurator: onlyOwner ownership transfer
DutchExchange.setupDutchExchange: one-time initializer of all core addresses
DutchExchange.deposit: pulls tokens via transferFrom before crediting the internal balance
DutchExchange.withdraw: debits balance then transfers tokens out
DutchExchange.postSellOrder: routes a sell order to the current or next auction using time checks
DutchExchange.postBuyOrder: buys into a running auction and may trigger auction clearing
DutchExchange.claimSellerFunds: pays out seller proceeds and issues fee-reduction tokens
DutchExchange.claimBuyerFunds: pays out buyer proceeds plus a share of extraTokens
DutchExchange.clearAuction: finalizes closing prices and rolls auction state forward
DutchExchange.settleFee: computes and books the fee for an order
DutchExchange.settleFeeSecondPart: converts the fee to USD and burns OWL to reduce it
DutchExchange.getCurrentAuctionPrice: time-dependent price decay used by buyers and clearing
DutchExchange.addTokenPair: validates funding against the oracle and opens a new pair
DutchExchange.updateMasterCopy: activates a proposal after the delay elapses
DutchExchange.startMasterCopyCountdown: schedules a new implementation 30 days ahead
DutchExchange.initiateEthUsdOracleUpdate: schedules a new oracle proposal
DutchExchange.updateEthUSDOracle: activates the oracle proposal after the delay
DutchExchange.getFeeRatio: derives the fee fraction from the user's locked FRT balance
DutchExchange.issueFrts: mints FRT rewards for approved token pairs
DutchExchange.closeTheoreticalClosedAuction: forces an auction clear when outstanding volume is zero
DutchExchange.scheduleNextAuction: decides whether the next auction starts or waits for funding
DutchExchange.setAuctionStart: writes a timestamp based auction start
DutchExchange.setAuctionIndex: increments the pair auction index
DutchExchange.updateApprovalOfToken: auctioneer-managed token whitelist
TokenFRT.updateMinter: owner-only one-time minter assignment
TokenFRT.mintTokens: minter-only minting of locked balances and supply
TokenFRT.unlockTokens: moves locked tokens into an unlock slot and stamps withdrawal time with now
TokenFRT.withdrawUnlockedTokens: time-gated release of unlocked tokens
TokenFRT.lockTokens: moves free balance into the locked (fee reducing) bucket
TokenOWL.mintOWL: minter-only mint of OWL
TokenOWL.burnOWL: spends allowance and burns OWL from a user
TokenOWL.setMinter: creator-only minter assignment
TokenOWL.updateMasterCopy: time-gated implementation swap
TokenOWL.startMasterCopyCountdown: schedules a new implementation 30 days ahead
StandardToken.transfer: balance moves guarded by safeToSub/safeToAdd
StandardToken.transferFrom: allowance and balance moves guarded by safe math
Proxy fallback: delegatecall into masterCopy forwarding all calldata
Math.exp: fixed point exponential with bound checks
Math.ln: fixed point natural logarithm
DSMath.mul: asserted multiplication
DSMath.add: asserted addition
